title: 700 MB asset: eviction at a 1.5 GiB quota, OPFS (CDP quota) and IndexedDB (quotaBytes) (Sprint 1 done-when, part 3)

commit.note: No commit hash was recorded. The run was made on the uncommitted Sprint 1 working tree; the first commit of this repository (ccf10b6) was made at 12:22 on 2026-11-09, after the run.

machine.label: Apple M5 Pro 48 GB
machine.browser: Google Chrome 157.0.8103.38, Playwright 1.65.0 channel "chrome", Node v22.22.3

method: The lane downloads a (700 MB), then b (400 MB), reads a back with getBlob (so a is more recent than b), then downloads c (500 MB) under a 1.5 GiB (1610612736 B) quota and records the events, the index rows, the files left in the store and the wall time of the whole sequence. OPFS: the origin quota is set through CDP Storage.overrideQuotaForOrigin, with no quotaBytes injection, so Chrome throws QuotaExceededError itself. IndexedDB: quotaBytes is injected, because Chrome ignores the CDP override for that store (see idb-usage-reporting.json). The figures the README quotes are the OPFS file of the first retest round (9582 ms) and the IndexedDB file of the second round (6252 ms, after the manager began counting its own stored bytes). The second round OPFS file is kept as a second OPFS run.
